keywords: Kohaku 全栈隐私仍有长路
L1 zkEVM 专场 #03 议程
summary: 周日较安静。chunter-cb 的 EIP-8130 合约更新合并。binji_x 强调钱包本身不安全时链上隐私毫无意义，kassandraETH 回应 Kohaku 想解决这个问题，但兼顾好 UX 与通用标准的全栈链上隐私仍很难。

keywords_en: Kohaku's long road to full stack privacy
summary_en: A quiet Sunday. chunter-cb's EIP-8130 contract updates merged. binji_x stressed that onchain privacy is meaningless if the wallet itself can be compromised, and kassandraETH replied that Kohaku wants to fix this but full stack onchain privacy with good UX and a common standard is still very hard.
